description: Fetch and extract readable content from a specific Nightbreak wiki page such as "EliteMobs/lua_getting_started". Page names change as the wiki grows: take them from search_wiki results. A missing page returns `suggestions` with the closest existing pages.

path.description: Wiki page path relative to the site root, for example "EliteMobs/lua_getting_started" or "EliteMobs/creating_bosses".

name: fetch_wiki_page
